verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred axis and order (logo, product, Glow, CTA). Its flaws are a fairly small product and a large dead gap between the product and 'Glow'. B moves the logo strip to the top right, off the centre axis everything else uses, and blows the CTA pill up until it competes with the headline.

A has the off-axis top-right logo and an oversized CTA, but the reading order is intact. B gives the product a better size, but drops the logo to the very bottom under the CTA, on the edge of the decorative circle. That breaks the brand-first reading order and makes the brand an afterthought.

A has the off-axis top-right logo and a heavy, oversized CTA. B keeps everything on one centre axis with fairly even spacing. However, it moves 'Glow' above the product, which departs from the original order, and it shrinks the product so it looks undersized for the 300px width.
